name: drawio-skill
works_with: Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, OpenClaw, Codex, Autohand Code, Hermes and other agents that load skills
short: Has your agent make editable draw.io diagrams from a description, your code, Terraform, SQL or API schemas.
what: This skill produces real `.drawio` files you can keep editing, not flat pictures. It writes the diagram, exports a PNG, checks it for overlaps and clipped labels, and fixes them. It can also build diagrams from code, Terraform, Kubernetes, SQL, OpenAPI and CI files, keep them in sync as the source changes, and test them against architecture rules.
who: Developers and architects who want diagrams they can edit by hand later, for docs, decks or reviews. If you only need diagrams as code inside Markdown, the author points you to a Mermaid or PlantUML skill instead.
needs: The draw.io desktop app for exports. Version 30 or later is recommended

steps.title: Install the draw.io desktop CLI
steps.text: On macOS use Homebrew. On Windows and Linux, get the installer or package from the drawio-desktop releases page. Check it with `drawio --version`.

steps.title: Install the skill
steps.text: Works for any agent through the skills CLI.

steps.title: Or install it by hand for Claude Code
steps.text: Clone once, then link the skill folder. Use `cp -R` instead of `ln -s` if your agent doesn't follow symlinks.

steps.title: Check your setup
steps.text: Run from the skill folder. It doesn't launch GUI tools unless you pass `--probe`.

try.label: From the README
try.text: Create a microservices e-commerce architecture with Mobile/Web/Admin clients, API Gateway (auth + rate limiting + routing), Auth/User/Order/Product/Payment services, Kafka message queue, Notification service, and User DB / Order DB / Product DB / Redis Cache / Stripe API

watch: The SKILL.md sets `disable-model-invocation: true`, so you may need to call the skill by name rather than wait for your agent to pick it up.
The skill lets your agent run commands, read and write files and fetch web pages.
AI logos load from the unpkg CDN when the diagram renders. Use `--embed` to keep them offline.
Don't put secrets in diagram properties. The SKILL.md warns they get embedded in the outputs.
